_meta.source: Written for claudeDM (Sci-Fi category). Mostly original; a few general-mechanics sentences (e.g. opportunity attacks, passive checks, stat-block phrasing) are adapted from SRD 5.1, licensed CC BY 4.0 — see NOTICE.
_meta.notes: Sci-Fi adversaries in the same schema as data/rules/monsters.json so LookupMonster can read either file. Weapon actions follow the gunplay rules in combat.json: ranged attacks list range and magazine; 'Burst' lines give the -2 to-hit and extra damage die; Full Auto and Suppressive Fire are DEX/WIS save actions with DC 8 + proficiency + DEX modifier. Grenades and launchers use the fixed DCs of their equipment entries. Undead use type 'undead' (zombies), aliens 'aberration', robots and exo-frames 'construct'. Suppressed, Bleeding and Shaken appear in condition_immunities where relevant. Each entry also carries an 'eras' tag. XP follows the standard XP-by-CR table.

actions.desc: Full Auto (10 rounds). The shooter sprays a 10-ft cube whose nearest edge is within 120 ft. Each creature in the cube, friend or foe, must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Cover adds to the save.

actions.name: Combat Knife
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Frag Grenade
actions.desc: The creature throws a grenade to a point within 30/60 ft. (carries 1). Each creature within 20 ft of that point must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Cover adds to the save.

actions.name: Flashbang
actions.desc: The creature throws a flashbang to a point within 30/60 ft. (carries 1). Each creature within 15 ft of that point must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) thunder damage and be blinded and deafened until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Precision Fire
special_abilities.desc: The operator can Aim as a bonus action even after moving up to 10 ft this turn.

special_abilities.name: Shrug It Off
special_abilities.desc: When the operator would become Suppressed or Shaken, it can ignore the condition. It can do this once per short rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The brute makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Debris
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Car doors, chunks of concrete, other zombies.

special_abilities.name: Hard to Put Down
special_abilities.desc: When damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, roll a d6 unless the damage was fire or came from a critical hit (a called shot to the head that hits is a critical hit). On a 4-6 it drops to 1 hit point instead and keeps coming.

special_abilities.name: Drawn by Noise
special_abilities.desc: The creature moves toward the loudest sound it can hear. Unsuppressed gunfire within half a mile draws it and every other zombie in that range.

special_abilities.name: Bullet Sponge
special_abilities.desc: The brute's resistance to piercing damage doesn't apply to critical hits (including head shots) or to armor-piercing weapons.

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the brute moves at least 20 ft straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Slam, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft and knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hunter makes two Claw attacks, or two Spine Volley attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spine Volley
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage. Armor-piercing.

special_abilities.name: Chameleon Skin
special_abilities.desc: The hunter has advantage on Stealth checks. If it hasn't moved this turn, it is invisible to creatures more than 30 ft away that lack thermal or motion sensors.

special_abilities.name: Pounce
special_abilities.desc: If the hunter leaps at least 20 ft toward a creature and hits it with a Claw on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone; the hunter can make one more Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Terror in the Dark
special_abilities.desc: A creature that sees the hunter kill someone must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become Shaken.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spymaster makes two Suppressed Pistol attacks.

actions.name: Suppressed Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. Magazine 15, reload bonus action. Suppressed: heard only within about 60 ft.

actions.name: Puppet Strings
actions.desc: As a bonus action, one ally within 60 ft that can hear the spymaster (by voice or earpiece) can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack.

special_abilities.name: Three Steps Ahead
special_abilities.desc: The spymaster has advantage on initiative rolls and can't be surprised. If the players have met it before, it knows one of their plans.

special_abilities.name: Leverage
special_abilities.desc: The spymaster always has something on someone: in social scenes, it has advantage on Deception, Intimidation and Persuasion checks against anyone it has investigated.

reactions.name: Contingency Plan (1/Day)
reactions.desc: When the spymaster is reduced to half its hit points or fewer, it reveals a prepared escape: it moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, and 1d4 Field Agents (or Bodyguards) arrive at the edge of the scene at the start of the next round.

actions.name: Overwhelm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage. Reach 0 ft.: one creature in the horde's space. The damage is 2d6 + 3 instead if the horde has half its hit points or fewer. The horde makes one Overwhelm attack against every creature in its space. Campaign infection rules apply.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: The horde can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature. It can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points. Every 20 hit points of damage it takes is roughly one zombie down.

special_abilities.name: Many Bodies
special_abilities.desc: The horde's resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage doesn't apply to full auto, explosives, fire or other area effects. Single shots and bursts kill one zombie in a crowd of dozens.

special_abilities.name: Drag Down
special_abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the horde's space must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be grappled and restrained by the mass (escape DC 13). A restrained creature is dragged along when the horde moves.

special_abilities.name: Drawn by Noise
special_abilities.desc: The creature moves toward the loudest sound it can hear. Unsuppressed gunfire within half a mile draws it and every other zombie in that range.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The exo-frame makes two Hydraulic Fist attacks, or one Hydraulic Fist attack and one Shoulder Autocannon attack.

actions.name: Hydraulic Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft and knocked prone.

actions.name: Shoulder Autocannon
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) piercing damage. Magazine 100, reload action. Burst (3 rounds): +1 to hit, 16 (3d10) piercing damage on a hit, no ability modifier.

actions.name: Full Auto
actions.desc: Full Auto (10 rounds). The shooter sprays a 10-ft cube whose nearest edge is within 150 ft. Each creature in the cube, friend or foe, must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Cover adds to the save.

actions.name: Rocket Pod (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The frame launches rockets at a point within 600 ft. Each creature within 10 ft of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Hard cover in the area is destroyed.

special_abilities.name: Exposed Pilot
special_abilities.desc: A called shot (-5) can target the pilot instead of the frame: the pilot has AC 13 and 30 hit points. If the pilot drops to 0 HP, the frame shuts down. The pilot can still be Shaken.

special_abilities.name: Armored Hull
special_abilities.desc: The frame takes no damage from attacks that deal 5 damage or less, unless they are armor-piercing.

special_abilities.name: EMP Susceptible
special_abilities.desc: If the frame fails a saving throw against an EMP grenade, it is stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The commander makes three attacks: Assault Rifle (single shots) or Combat Knife, in any combination; a burst replaces two single shots.

actions.name: Assault Rifle
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 120/360 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. Magazine 30, reload bonus action. Burst (3 rounds): +3 to hit, 10 (3d6) piercing damage on a hit, no ability modifier.

actions.name: Full Auto
actions.desc: Full Auto (10 rounds). The shooter sprays a 10-ft cube whose nearest edge is within 120 ft. Each creature in the cube, friend or foe, must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Cover adds to the save.

actions.name: Combat Knife
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Frag Grenade
actions.desc: The creature throws a grenade to a point within 30/60 ft. (carries 2). Each creature within 20 ft of that point must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Cover adds to the save.

actions.name: Coordinated Fire (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: As a bonus action, up to three allies within 60 ft who can hear the commander can each use their reaction to make one weapon attack.

special_abilities.name: Veteran of Many Wars
special_abilities.desc: The commander has advantage on saving throws against being Suppressed, Shaken or frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The overseer makes two Tendril attacks.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 15). The overseer has four tendrils.

actions.name: Mind Lash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Each creature of the overseer's choice within 30 ft must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage and becoming Shaken on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Psychic Command
actions.desc: As a bonus action, one Alien Drone or Alien Hunter within 1 mile can use its reaction to move up to its speed and make one attack.

special_abilities.name: Hive Link
special_abilities.desc: The overseer shares the senses of every hive creature within 1 mile. If the overseer dies, every hive creature within 1 mile is stunned until the end of its next turn and then fights without coordination.

special_abilities.name: Alien Mind
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the overseer's mind (telepathy, a Synthetic jacking into its tech) must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become Shaken.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The assassin makes two attacks: Suppressed Pistol or Combat Knife, in any combination.

actions.name: Suppressed Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. Magazine 15, reload bonus action. Suppressed: heard only within about 60 ft.

actions.name: Combat Knife
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. The blade is coated in a toxin; a creature immune to poison takes only the slashing damage.

actions.name: Sniper Rifle
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 400/1600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. Magazine 5, reload action. Suppressed: heard only within about 60 ft.

special_abilities.name: Assassinate
special_abilities.desc: During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit it scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

special_abilities.name: Precision Strike
special_abilities.desc: Once per turn, the assassin deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits with a weapon attack and has advantage on the roll, or when an ally of the assassin is within 5 ft of the target.

special_abilities.name: Evasion
special_abilities.desc: When the assassin makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage, it takes no damage on a success and half on a failure.

9.name: Alien Walker

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The walker makes two Stomp attacks.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Vehicles and structures take double damage.

actions.name: Bio-plasma Bombard (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The walker launches a glob of bio-plasma at a point within 300 ft. Each creature within 20 ft of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Soft cover in the area burns away.

actions.name: Brood Sac (1/Day)
actions.desc: When the walker is first reduced to half its hit points or fewer, it splits open a sac on its belly and 2d4 Alien Drones drop to the ground beneath it. They act on the walker's initiative.

special_abilities.name: Armored Carapace
special_abilities.desc: Ordinary bullets ricochet off its shell: the walker has resistance to piercing damage unless the weapon is armor-piercing or the hit is on its weak point.

special_abilities.name: Weak Point
special_abilities.desc: A glowing gland beneath its body can be targeted with a called shot (-5). A hit is a critical hit and ignores its resistances.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: The walker deals double damage to objects, vehicles and structures.

damage_resistances: piercing (from weapons without the armor-piercing property)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The queen makes four attacks: one Bite, two Claw and one Tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The queen sprays acid in a 30-ft cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Soft cover and light armor in the cone are ruined.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Actions
special_abilities.desc: The queen can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options listed under legendary_actions. Only one option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

special_abilities.name: Hive Mother
special_abilities.desc: Every hive creature within 1 mile shares the queen's senses and has advantage on attack rolls while the queen is in combat. If the queen dies, every hive creature within 1 mile is Shaken and flees or fights to the death (GM's choice).

special_abilities.name: Egg Chamber
special_abilities.desc: The queen fights in its lair: the floor is difficult terrain for non-hive creatures and full of hiding places for drones.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Lash
legendary_actions.desc: The queen makes one Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Summon Brood
legendary_actions.desc: 1d4 Alien Drones emerge from the hive walls within 30 ft of the queen.

legendary_actions.name: Shift
legendary_actions.desc: The queen moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
